strategy_notes: ACCELERATED DEPLOYMENT PHASE — Moving from 30% to ~50% deployed across 5 positions. Key evolution: (1) MACD bearish signals are confirmed as lagging/false negatives in strong uptrends near ATH — price action (higher lows, sector breadth, breakout volume) now overrides MACD for entry timing. (2) When SPY makes new highs with >60% of top-50 green, treat as confirmed momentum regime. (3) Pilot positions at 10% each — add to winners showing 3-day confirmation up to 20%. (4) Maintain 4% stop losses on pilots. (5) Profit-taking at +5-7% in MACD-bearish environments, but extend to +8-10% when price action shows sustained momentum. (6) If 3 of 5 pilots hit stops, cut all and go 100% cash. (7) 80% win rate preserved by sector diversification (semis + enterprise software + mega-cap tech). Opportunity cost lesson: sitting 90%+ cash in a 37% YoY rally market is a strategy failure.
